caption_L1: Burkina Faso : Distribution of gross domestic product (GDP) across economic sectors from 2009 to 2019 is a line plot. The x-axis plots Year with linear scale with a minimum of 2010 and a maximum of 2018 while the y-axis plots Industry along scale from 0.00 to 0.30.
caption_L2L3: In the charte, we can observe an initial increment in the Industry GDP from around 0.24 (in 2009) to about 0.28 (in 2011), followed by a return to the initial level in 2013. After that, there was a period of small variations (0.24-0.25) until 2017, where a decline started, with the level falling to around 0.22 by 2019.
